result.title: Future-Informed Actor-Critic
result.summary: Actor-critic methods optimize a parametrized policy using a critic to estimate their policy gradient. Recent work has shown that conditioning the critic on features of future states, actions, or rewards can improve sample efficiency and even final return. However, existing methods are restricted to exogenous features (independent of actions), overlooking endogenous features (dependent on actions) that may be crucial for credit assignment. We introduce the future-informed value function, which can be conditioned on both exogenous and endogenous features of future states, actions, and rewards. Then, we express the policy gradient using this value function, yielding the future-informed policy gradient. Building on that, we propose the future-informed actor-critic algorithm. Empirical results show that this algorithm leveraging endogenous features of the future outperforms standard actor-critic algorithms in environments with noisy and sparse rewards.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「未来知情价值函数」，使 critic 可同时以未来状态、动作与奖励的外生和内生特征为条件，并据此导出未来知情策略梯度与相应 actor-critic 算法，在噪声与稀疏奖励环境中优于标准 actor-critic。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用未来信息（尤其依赖动作的内生特征）改善贡献分配的做法，可能为 latent 推理轨迹训练中的信用分配与中间状态监督提供线索，可供核查如何用后续状态的 latent 特征作为训练信号。
